lines.1: ...The scent of a shampoo I never used.
lines.3: Hmm. I had mixed feelings about this.
lines.5: A whole row of products for Otome now stood beside mine.
lines.6: I relaxed in the tub for the first time in ages.
lines.9: 「Soak up to your shoulders and count to one hundred.」
lines.11: W-what was with her? What was she trying to do?
lines.12: --You may think of me as an older sister.
lines.13: Oh, right. She was acting like my sister.
lines.14: ...For one second, I had thought she might offer to wash my back.
lines.15: I wasn't Fukahire. I needed to reflect on that.
